{{Quote|In honor of Ahto University professor, Doctor Narlan Syphus. Though his home and family were far from our waters, he dedicated his life to the protection and preservation of Manaan’s creatures.|A placard on Manaan|<ref name="codex"/>}}
[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Narlan Syphus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Professor/Legends|professor]] who taught at [[Ahto University]]. He taught that [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] was a collective 'organism', and that the Galaxy, with its corrupting influences, would endanger this organism. Although Syphus was not a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]], his teaching were highly influential and spawned a Selkath isolationist movement which called themselves the [[Syphus Collective]]. After peacefully preaching Doctor Syphus' ideas for many years, after the Manaan government refused to be neutral in the upcoming [[Third Galactic War]], the group turned into a terrorist movement to achieve their goals.<ref name="codex"/>
